description: EXPR-DOMAIN, missing variant: what DCount sees across two Workspaces in one process. Dtx(id) is empty. A second Workspace (own Database object on the same file) BeginTrans, INSERT id 1: DCount('*', 'Dtx') is read through the first Database and through the second; Rollback and read; BeginTrans, INSERT id 2, CommitTrans and read; a dynaset AddNew with id = 50 in the second Workspace is read through both before and after its Update; and the first Workspace's own uncommitted INSERT id 3 is read through the second Database before and after Rollback. Follow-up probe (round 2) for EXPR-DOMAIN; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q2-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120. Each DAO statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
